# Better Business Bureau (BBB)

> > The Better Business Bureau is a trusted nonprofit organization helping consumers find accredited businesses, file complaints, and protect themselves from scams and fraud.

BBB.org serves as a comprehensive resource for consumer protection and business verification across the United States and Canada. With over 110 years of history, BBB maintains a directory of accredited businesses, operates the BBB Scam Tracker database, and provides educational resources to help consumers make informed decisions.

## Key Topics

- BBB Accreditation
- Business Directory
- Consumer Complaints
- Scam Reporting
- Fraud Prevention
- Business Credibility

## Consumer Protection & Fraud Prevention

- [Report a Scam](https://www.bbb.org/scamtracker/reportscam): Report scams and fraud to BBB Scam Tracker database
- [Search for Scams](https://www.bbb.org/scamtracker/lookupscam): Search BBB's scam database and view reported fraud schemes
- [Scam Prevention](https://www.bbb.org/all/scam-prevention): BBB scam prevention guide and fraud awareness educational resources
- [File a Complaint](https://www.bbb.org/file-a-complaint): File consumer complaints against businesses and track complaint status
- [BBB Tax Tips & Resources](https://www.bbb.org/article/news-releases/21492-bbb-tip-how-to-choose-a-tax-preparer): Tax season tips, scam prevention, and hiring tax preparer guidance

## Business Directory & Search

- [BBB Homepage](https://www.bbb.org): BBB homepage: find accredited businesses, file complaints, report scams
- [Get a Quote from a BBB Accredited Business](https://www.bbb.org/get-a-quote): Request quotes from BBB accredited businesses and service providers
- [Review a Business](https://www.bbb.org/leave-a-review): Write and submit reviews for businesses on BBB directory

## Business Accreditation

- [Get Accredited: Learn more about BBB Accreditation](https://www.bbb.org/get-accredited): Learn about BBB accreditation benefits and standards for businesses
- [BBB Accreditation Application](https://www.bbb.org/apply): Apply for BBB accreditation as a business owner or operator

## About BBB

- [About Better Business Bureau](https://www.bbb.org/all/about-bbb): Overview of Better Business Bureau's 110+ year history and mission

## Optional

- [Manage Your Cookie Preferences](https://www.bbb.org/manage-cookies): Cookie preferences and privacy settings management page
